title: Model-free Bayesian Clustering and Multimodal Posterior Summarisation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13397v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop a model-free, noise-aware Bayesian clustering framework that constructs a martingale posterior over clusterings from a predictive Bayesian perspective. This avoids explicit likelihood-prior model specification, expensive MCMC sampling, and mode-seeking variational approximations, while accommodating irregular cluster shapes and enabling parallel generation of posterior draws. To interpret the posterior over high-dimensional, noise-aware clusterings, we introduce a Wasserstein-type summarization method. Using a novel noise-aware loss, this approach compresses the large collection of posterior draws into a small set of weighted representatives, capturing distinct cluster structures and noise assignments. Further, we marginalise the uncertainty in the density level, avoiding reliance on a specific choice. We establish theoretical properties of the proposed loss and guarantees for the level-marginal posterior approximation. Resu

translated_title: 无模型贝叶斯聚类与多模态后验摘要
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个无模型、噪声感知的贝叶斯聚类框架，该框架从预测贝叶斯的视角构建聚类划分上的鞅后验。这一方法避免了显式的似然-先验模型设定、昂贵的MCMC采样以及寻求众数的变分近似，同时能够适应不规则的簇形状，并支持后验样本的并行生成。为了解释高维、噪声感知聚类上的后验分布，我们引入了一种Wasserstein类型的摘要方法。利用一种新颖的噪声感知损失，该方法将大量后验样本压缩为少量的加权代表，从而捕捉不同的簇结构与噪声分配情况。此外，我们对密度水平的不确定性进行边缘化处理，避免了对特定密度水平选择的依赖。我们建立了所提损失的理论性质，并为水平边缘化后验近似提供了理论保证。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无模型、噪声感知的贝叶斯聚类框架，通过鞅后验避免MCMC采样，并利用Wasserstein型摘要方法将多模态后验高效压缩为少量加权代表，同时边缘化了密度水平的不确定性。
